title: Baker Victory Services training to quantum unentangle

tellings.quote: at Baker Victory Services, a lot of their work was having you quantum unentangle with things that you were entangled with.

plain: At a place called Baker Victory Services, much of the work was training people to "quantum unentangle", which means cutting the hidden links that tie them to things they are connected with. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while interviewing a guest who says a UFO program took him as a child. If true, it would suggest the program was training people's minds, not just watching them.
